verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an API to create events for a profile (klaviyo-docs-30, klaviyo-docs-43) and flows triggered by those events that send branded notifications to recipients (klaviyo-docs-17). That is an indirect, event-triggered route to one-to-one email on the same platform used for campaigns (klaviyo-docs-7). However, the evidence shows no direct transactional send endpoint and nothing specific to receipts or magic links. missing for 10: a direct one-to-one transactional send API, documentation of transactional use cases such as receipts and magic links (deliverability, latency, templates), independent or hands-on corroboration.
